caption: The drawing features a geometric composition with floral motifs. The background consists of light beige lines and patterns forming diagonal and chevron shapes, with some feather-like forms accenting the design. The prominent elements in the composition are red flowers with yellow circular centers. These flowers are attached to green stems with multiple green leaves, each leaf having small red accents near the tips. The green stems and leaves curve and form arcs and corners, outlining sections of the drawing. The largest arc is in the lower right, with clusters of five-petaled red flowers spaced evenly along its length. The flowers and foliage are all drawn with solid, filled colors, contrasting sharply against the more delicately drawn background lines and shapes. The overall structure of the arrangement creates defined sections within the rectangular border of the drawing.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
